text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Like I said, Duramente-san, a "heavy 
board game" doesn't mean its physical 
weight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I was rather impressed, 
thinking it was a system designed with 
health in mind for indoor play.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You mean playing around while wearing 
weights? Hmm. That actually sounds like it 
could be fun.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still! In this case, "heavy" means heavy 
rules... In other words, it refers to a 
complex game.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"For example, having a lot of resources to 
manage...?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(The resources one must manage in a race 
are wide-ranging:\none's own body... 
stamina, strain on the bones,\nthe state 
of the horseshoes, and even one's mental 
state...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Also, your win rate can change 
dramatically depending on your 
knowledge...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(From track conditions, temperature, and 
humidity, to every runner's past race 
records...\nThe amount of information 
required for a race is limitless.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—...Which is why I usually don't recommend 
it to board game beginners, but... Um, are 
you listening?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I heard. Sounds like it'll be useful for 
training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Eh? ...Were you really listening to me?
